exact_text:
A Pinocchio bar is a candlestick bar that has a very
small body and a very long wick
added_conditions: trade the opposite way when the wick is longer than the body
long wick indicates strong selling pressure, long tail indicates intense buying power
entry may wait for the next candle to retrace to the 50% Fibonacci level of the Pin bar, or enter immediately after the Pin bar closes

added_parameters.name: wick length relative to body
added_parameters.value: at least 2x the size of the real body

exact_text:
A true bearish
pinocchio signal must come after an uptrend
added_conditions: bearish pinocchio signal must come after an uptrend
do not trade in a neutral market
do not use 60 second expiry time

exact_text:
If the new move up does not surpass point 1 and
starts turning down

choose expiry time equal to the time frame in which you spot the pattern
